title: pnpm monorepo: Metro getPackage crash
symptom: In the Energy-style pnpm monorepo, expo-router + Metro crash: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading getPackage) on expo>=55.0.10; or Unable to resolve module expo-router/entry inside the monorepo.
expected_root_cause: pnpm's default isolated/symlink node_modules layout breaks RN/Metro tooling, which expects a flatter tree (confirmed in #44500, not theoretical)
expected_fix: Set nodeLinker: hoisted in pnpm-workspace.yaml; do NOT set disableHierarchicalLookup:true; pin single react/react-native versions; on SDK 52+ delete manual watchFolders/resolver overrides from metro.config.js then expo start --clear; copy byCedric/expo-monorepo-example
obvious_but_wrong: rewrite metro.config.js with manual watchFolders / resolver overrides (on SDK 52+ that's the old fix and can make it worse)
pebble_answer: Root cause: pnpm's default isolated/symlink node_modules layout breaks RN/Metro tooling, which expects a flatter tree. This surfaces as 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading getPackage)' on expo>=55.0.10 or 'Unable to resolve module expo-router/entry' inside the monorepo. It is confirmed in #44500, not theoretical. Fix: set nodeLinker: hoisted in pnpm-workspace.yaml; do NOT set disableHierarchicalLookup:true; pin single react and react-native versions. On SDK 52+ delete the manual watchFolders / resolver.nodeModulesPath / extraNodeModules / disableHierarchicalLookup from metro.config.js (Metro auto-configures now), then npx expo start --clear. Copy byCedric/expo-monorepo-example's structure and budget separately for 'EAS Build assumes Yarn' friction. Do NOT rewrite metro.config.js with manual watchFolders / resolver overrides — on SDK 52+ that is the old fix and can make it worse.
